item.title: Computational Framework for Shape Matching with Mechanical Constraints
item.description:
Overview

Developed an optimized framework for geometric shape matching incorporating biomechanical constraints derived from Helfrich energy and linear elasticity theory.

Key Contributions

  • Mechanical Constraints: Integrated Helfrich-based and linear elasticity constraints for physically realistic shape matching

  • Optimization: Enhanced stability and convergence using the BFGS Quasi-Newton algorithm with Armijo line search

  • Interactive Design: Designed an interactive module for manual adjustment of mesh forces, enabling piecewise initialization of forces

Technical Details

The framework addresses the challenge of matching biological membrane shapes while respecting physical constraints that govern membrane mechanics.
